name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with no inner ring for keyboard navigation. This meets WCAG 2.2 AA for focus visibility while keeping the interface clean. Trade-off: the thinner ring may feel less prominent on high-DPI screens, but it avoids visual clutter and maintains 4.5:1 contrast against both light and dark backgrounds.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring fails on low-contrast patterned backgrounds where the 2px gap between ring and element blends into the texture. A 3px ring with a 1px inner #ffffff ring (total 4px) keeps WCAG 2.2 AA contrast on all backgrounds while avoiding visual heaviness—test it on your densest UI screens. Settle it with a 10-minute A/B test on the most problematic page.
